# Citations

A bracketed citation [@arrow1951], a group [@arrow1951; @sen1970], a prefix and suffix [see @sen1970, p. 3], a suffix with no comma [@arrow1951 p. 12], a group with a locator [@arrow1951, p. 3; also @sen1970], and a suppressed author [-@arrow1951].

A bare key is a citation too: @sen1970 says so, and @arrow1951 [p. 33] adds a locator.

A key with a label prefix is a reference, bare or bracketed: @eq:welfare and [@eq:welfare].

$$
W = \sum_i u_i
$$ {#eq:welfare}

```{=bibtex}
@book{arrow1951,
  author = {Arrow, Kenneth J.},
  title = {Social Choice and Individual Values},
  publisher = {Wiley},
  year = {1951}
}

@book{sen1970,
  author = {Sen, Amartya},
  title = {Collective Choice and Social Welfare},
  publisher = {Holden-Day},
  year = {1970}
}
```
